messages:
elaine: Quick sync — we need a decision on the routing MVP vs v1 for the latency-sensitive pipeline. Acme pilot is asking for sub-200ms p95 on short prompts. That constraint touches serving, caching, and Dedicated capacity. Proposing three paths (A/B/C) below, want quick tradeoff call by EOD.

sam: quick question — is the 200ms req strict for pilot or negotiable?

elaine: customer said it's for product demo on Wed. pretty firm but may accept 250ms if we add fallback UI.

viv: dev note: to hit 200ms p95 we need:
```
- prefix KV cache enabled
- hot-model pinned on Dedicated slab (2x throughput)
- batching window < 5ms (continuous batching tuned)
```
Cost estimate: ~+35% token cost on hosted fallback, or +$6k/mo on Dedicated slab.

marc: framing the options: A) ship MVP with soft tail SLO (250ms) + UI fallback, B) MVP with cached routing + limited Dedicated for pilot (meets 200ms but limited qps), C) defer strict tail to v1 and ship feature light (routing + visibility only).

olga: UX impact: fallback UI is doable but hurts demo polish. Can we limit fallbacks to specific flows? yes.

sam: what about automatic fallthrough to smaller responses to shave latency? quality tradeoff there.

viv: we can implement token trimming heuristics, but regressions on NLU are possible. need an eval set.

elaine: decision heuristics I care about:
- demo integrity (Acme asks)
- measurable SLO by customer (200ms p95)
- cost delta and ops complexity
- rollback surface (if it fails)

marc: propose quick rubric: if gated cost < $8k/mo and engineering effort < 2 sprint-weeks -> choose B. else choose A with UI fallback and schedule B for v1.

sam: +1 to rubric. who owns the eval set?

viv: runtime team can assemble a 50-scenario eval from prod prompts in 48h. will need product to define quality thresholds.

elaine: olga, can you draft fallback UI flows for demo by EOD? olga: yes, will drop screenshots in thread.

viv: doing a rough perf run now on canary. deploy-bot: canary rollout started for commit 5a3c2b; monitor at /dash/latency-canary

marc: I'll run cost calc and send numbers in 2 hours.

elaine: plan for today:
- viv: perf run + rough confirm whether caching + Dedicated meets 200ms under demo qps (target 2h)
- marc: cost calc (2h)
- olga: fallback mockups (EOD)
- sam: confirm product messaging for pilot (EOD)
If all green -> pick B for pilot and gate on finance sign-off. If not -> pick A and schedule B for v1.

sam: noted. tagging @viv @marc @olga for updates. :thumbsup:

viv: perf run done — caching + 1 Dedicated slab hits ~190ms p95 at demo QPS, CPU and GPU headroom ok. will upload logs.

marc: cost calc done — Dedicated slab + ops + infra delta ~ $7.2k/mo, fits rubric.

elaine: decision: choose B for pilot. prepare a short internal runbook:
- pin hot model variant to Dedicated slab
- enable prefix KV cache for pilot tenant only
- set rolling canary and fallback UI toggles
- alerting: p95 tail > 210ms triggers rollback to A

sam: ok, will update pilot playbook and messaging.

olga: mockups uploaded: https://redwood.design/threads/1950004321/fallback-mock.png

viv: uploading perf logs to /s3/redwood/perf/1950004321.zip

deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed to 10% of pilot traffic.

eleaine_typo_fix: (tiny) *elaine: thanks team — I'll prep the external pilot note for Acme.*
